review_conflicts.details: 2025-10-29 issuer article expected completion winter 2026; current undated issuer listing projects winter 2027. Retain both with forecast version, no actual handover.
2023-11-30 announcement forecast autumn 2025 handover; current issuer listing forecasts autumn 2026. Do not mark delivered.
12 Dec 2024 was inauguration; publisher later says first residents were present by 15 May 2025 and current overview describes 2025 handover. No exact first residential handover day confirmed.
Dec 2024 issuer announcement has 992 apartments and 19,196 m2; current overview rounds to ~1,000 apartments and 19,000 m2. Store precise source-specific figures; don't add numbers.
Habitat 4.1 hectares is total 11-tower multi-phase project, not Phase I site area.
As of Oct 2020 issuer said handover in progress, later 2022 corporate statement says phase completed and handed over; do not backdate completion of all units.
No WGS84 independently crosschecked, no contractual usable vs gross area basis for unit-size ranges. Address claims are publisher references only; no current official cadastral review.
